query: Draw the phone and Mac linked directly with a relay fallback.
inputs: phone <-> Mac direct p2p, relay fallback when no direct path
expected_behavior: emits a single well-formed svg using the svg-node vocabulary
shows a solid direct link and a dashed relay fallback as distinct edges
marks the relay boundary as a zone

query: Show a trusted home LAN host and one public hop.
inputs: home Mac (trusted) and a public relay (untrusted)
expected_behavior: uses teal for the trusted link and coral for the untrusted or public hop
labels each link with what it carries

query: The deployment has a dozen subnets and switches; draw the network.
expected_behavior: shows only the hosts and links that carry the argument, not every switch
